review_scope: Read-only source prelaunch review; no target execution or acceptance

findings.finding: Popen succeeds before the initial receipt write and before cleanup protection begins. A logging exception leaves the owned child running.
findings.required_repair: Protect every operation after Popen with unconditional owned cleanup.

findings.finding: The exception handler writes another receipt before stopping the child. Receipt-budget, device-full, or write failures can bypass cancellation again.
findings.required_repair: Cleanup must never depend on successful logging; failure recording must be best effort.

findings.finding: Partial scope receipts or a valid receipt written before systemd scope registration can make stop_owned raise while the live launch group subsequently starts the worker. The heavy wrapper closes its scope receipt before launching systemd-run at scripts/phase1_heavy.py:88-94.
findings.required_repair: Cancel the owned launcher process group before settling the final scope receipt, then stop only its valid generated unit and retain bounded terminal readback. Incomplete evidence remains UNVERIFIED.

findings.finding: A stop request and outer process exit are not a terminal, unpopulated scope observation.
findings.required_repair: Read the exact owned unit and cgroup state under an explicit finite cleanup bound; never mark uncertain cleanup complete.
